replacements.baseline_literal: A small dark floral clasp at the collar echoes the cargo's living blossoms.
replacements.final_literal: At her collar, a charcoal silk rosette is built from folded cloth petals with visibly doubled hem edges; in the case beside her hand, separate ivory blossoms have soft botanical petals connected to their own brown stems. A quiet pewter glint catches the rosette's dense folds, while warm ivory light reveals the thin living petals on the twig she steadies.
effects: folded cloth and doubled hem edges
separate botanical ivory petals joined to brown stems
dense cloth folds versus thin living petals

baseline_overlap_causal_limit: The baseline already had gothic serenity, black botanical lace, flowers, a dark floral clasp, subdued gold and ivory light, and tram cargo care. A successful render of those existing elements cannot prove a causal improvement from new DATA. Only the newly adopted explicit cloth-versus-living-flower relationship is a candidate-driven prompt delta; without an unmodified baseline render even its image-level causal benefit remains unproven.

not_selected_new_candidate.reason: Full closed-eye repose is compatible with open expression/pose but would reduce the visible attention-to-stem relation. Retaining open lowered gaze is an artistic preference, not a requester exclusion.
